Name: (CP)( Elisabeth the musical) Tod and Sisi Decorative Furniture
Author: Luozhu0901
Description:
A small Content Patcher furniture mod based on Elisabeth the musical (2026 China tour cast).
YOU NEED TO DOWNLOAD CONTENT PATCHER TO MAKE THIS MOD WORKS! (1915)
It adds decorative furniture versions of Tod and Sisi, including two slightly different Sisi versions based on Kristine and Lena. The only difference between them is the eye colour (hopefully I got it right🥺）. And also a black wings version of Tod.
They are ❗furniture, not NPCs❗, you can place them anywhere, but they are purely decorative and cannot be interacted with or talked to.
How to get them in-game:
After installing the mod, go to Robin’s shop and purchase the Furniture Catalogue. Then open the catalogue and you will find them there. (Yes, you are buying them from Robin but not Robin Reitsma.🤣🤣🤣)
With all my love to Elisabeth the musical and the casts.🔥🔥🔥

只是一个基于2026一粒沙中巡卡做的Tod & Sisi小摆件。（使用了CP模组前置，必须要安装CP模组才能运行！！CP模组尾号是1915以防你们不知道）
Kristine和Lena版本的Sisi我都做了，虽然她们basically其实只有眼睛颜色不同。以及tod有多一个黑色小翅膀版本for no reason。
❗此mod并不是一个npc mod，只是一个放着好玩的furniture❗因此不能对话也不能交互。
关于如何使用：
安装完去Robin家购买家具目录，打开这个目录往下翻就可以找着。（我知道这很奇怪，但不是Robin Reitsma，是星露谷里那个木匠店老板🤣🤣🤣）
